title: Diamond Diadem
description: Whenever you play [blue]2[/blue] or fewer cards in a turn, take half damage from enemies.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: At the end of each turn, if you have played 2 or fewer cards, this relic triggers its effect. The relic displays a counter showing the number of cards played in the current turn during combat.
